blocks.html: Residents of the City of Pasig now have a more accessible, convenient, and safer place for their business registration, tax assessment and payment, regulatory permit application covering Barangays Dela Paz, Manggahan, and Santolan, and soon other local government transactions. Inaugurated on July 7, 2023, the new Pasig City Hall Annex 2 (Business One Stop Shop) located at the 3rd level of Robinsons Metro East provides residents not just easier and faster access to local government services but the convenience of the mall’s wide array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options, ample parking, and direct link to the LRT-2 station and other transport services.

Congressman Roman T. Romulo, Executive Vice President and Business Unit General Manager - Robinsons Malls Mr. Faraday D. Go, Pasig City Mayor Victor Ma Regis N. Sotto, RLC President and CEO and Presidential Adviser on Investment and Economic Affairs Secretary Frederick D. Go and Pasig City Administrator Atty. Jeronimo U. Manzanero officially inaugurated the new Pasig City Hall Annex 2.
